title: Virtual Compute: refund assessment — positive assessment
content:
## Calculation basis

Virtual Compute refund assessment — Record the permitted refund amount rounded half-up to two USD decimals when it meets refund minimum inclusively; otherwise make no positive refund-eligibility assessment.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the judgement for refund assessment — positive assessment?**

Record the permitted refund amount rounded half-up to two USD decimals when it meets refund minimum inclusively; otherwise make no positive refund-eligibility assessment.
